name: MK Cards
subtitle: Digital business cards & NFC
promotionalText: Share your card with a QR code, link, NFC tag or Apple Wallet, and scan the cards of people you meet.
description:
MK Cards is your business card, always with you.

Create elegant digital cards for work, clients or events, in English and Arabic. Share them with a QR code, a link, an NFC tag or Apple Wallet. The person you meet needs no app: one tap saves your contact.

SHARE ANYWHERE
• Full-screen QR code, ready to scan
• Add your card to Apple Wallet
• Write your card to NFC stickers and cards
• Share your link in any app

NEVER LOSE A CONTACT
• Scan paper business cards: the details are read for you
• Scan event badges with a QR code
• Visitors can send you their details from your card page
• Save contacts to your iPhone, export them, or send them to Salesforce

LOOK PROFESSIONAL
• Formal card designs with your photo and company logo
• Email signatures with your QR code
• Video-call backgrounds for Zoom, Teams and Meet

KNOW WHAT WORKS
• See how often each card is viewed and saved

FOR COMPANIES
• Matching cards for the whole team, imported from a spreadsheet
• Sign in with Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace
• Switch cards off and show a message when someone leaves
• Company Salesforce connection and activity exports
reviewNotes:
1. SCREEN RECORDING (physical iPhone, latest iOS)
https://photos.icloud.com/shared/album/0453O2HJtIcXbA1EDfoLqlkLA
It starts with launching the app and shows signing in, the cards, sharing (QR, Apple Wallet), scanning, contacts and the account screen. Account creation: Welcome screen > "New here? Create an account". Account deletion: Account tab > Delete account (confirm with password).

2. PURPOSE AND AUDIENCE
MK Cards replaces paper business cards for professionals and companies. Users create digital business cards and share them by QR code, link, NFC tag or Apple Wallet; the person receiving it needs no app and saves the contact in one tap. Users can also scan other people's paper business cards and event badges so no contact is lost, and companies give their whole team matching cards. Audience: professionals, salespeople and companies.

3. HOW TO USE IT
Demo account (filled in above): username mkdemo. It is both an individual account and the owner of a company workspace ("Northwind Trading"), so it covers both account types; company members see the same app as individuals.
- Cards tab: two sample cards with statistics; tap a card for its views chart and actions (Edit, Preview, Email signature, Call background).
- Share tab: QR code full-size, Add to Apple Wallet, Write to an NFC tag (needs an NFC sticker).
- Scan tab: "Business card" opens the VisionKit document camera; photograph any printed business card, check the details and Save. "Event badge" opens the live QR scanner. "Type it in" adds a contact by hand.
- Contacts tab: sample contacts; swipe right to save to iPhone Contacts, swipe left to delete, tap for details.
- Account tab: sign-in methods, password, company admin (opens the company page), help, privacy, log out, delete account.
No sample files are needed. No purchases: the app sells nothing and has no paid features.

4. EXTERNAL SERVICES
- Cloudflare: hosting, database and Workers AI (reads the text of a photographed business card; photos are not stored).
- Apple: Sign in with Apple, Apple Wallet (PassKit), VisionKit/Vision on the device.
- Google Wallet API (passes for Android users), Google and Microsoft sign-in (optional, OpenID Connect, for company accounts).
- Salesforce (optional, only if the customer connects their own Salesforce account).

5. REGIONS
The app works the same in all regions. Cards can be written in English and Arabic.

6. REGULATED CONTENT
Not applicable: the app is not in a regulated industry and has no third-party protected material.

User-generated content: cards are only reachable by their own link or QR code; there is no feed or search of other users' cards and no messaging between users. Every public card page has a "Report this card" link to our support address, and we remove cards that break the rules.
